assumptions: Non-CSV files anywhere (including the package root) are silently dropped by 'keep only CSV'; only CSV files are checked for location.
CSV means the extension .csv in lower case.
The SITE folder must be the top-level folder; nested folders such as SITE_0001/sub/a.csv are refused.
{study} comes from the component setting and is rendered as e.g. D1234C00001.
The manifest lists only the zip, not itself, and is not placed inside the archive.

steps.title: Refuse unless there is at least one CSV and every CSV is directly in a SITE_nnnn folder
Bundle the CSV files into <package>.zip keeping SITE folders
Compute md5 and sha256 of the zip
Write manifest.json listing the zip with size, md5 and sha256

output.summary: Keeps only CSV files, refuses the package unless every CSV sits directly in a SITE_ folder with four digits (and at least one CSV exists), and names the package <study>_<ds_nodash>. It then zips the CSVs with their SITE_xxxx folders into <package>.zip. Finally it writes manifest.json beside the zip, listing the zip's size, md5 and sha256.
